title: Great Flamenco in Granada
text: Great atmosphere, show and friendly welcoming
author: GEHBadrianab

title: All was great
text: Great show, great setting right in the centre. Dancers and musicians were fantastic. And Reasonably priced drinks.
author: Tanya_P

title: A 10!!
text: The best flamenco show I have ever seen! The place is beautiful and Pedro is an excellent professional. A 10! I am sure we will repeat it!!
author: TrailBlazer656950

title: Quality flamenco in Granada.
text: A high-quality flamenco experience in one of the most emblematic areas of Granada. A perfect plan for couples.  Additionally, the attention from the staff was excellent, very close and professional. Totally recommended.
author: mariacR9837XE

title: Flamenco in the palace.
text:
Excellent service!
A very cozy and comfortable place.
Where to enjoy the best artists in the city.
We have visited several places searching for flamenco, and without a doubt, this is the best!
author: 508danyi

title: Flamenco with charm and a lot of spirit.
text: The palace is beautiful, the decoration is very well taken care of, and the show is sensational; the staff's treatment is top-notch. It is highly recommended; if you spend a few days in Granada, you cannot miss visiting it.
author: 882juanag

title: Flamenco Dancing in Granada
text: The Flamenco Dancers, Singers, and the Guitarist, were the very best that we have seen and heard!♥️  The  dance hall is unique with a small water fountain and a bar. This was classic!♥️
author: Salvador_M

title: Amazing
text: Just amazing. Had we been in Granada longer we would have come again. The skills and passion on display from the singers, dancers and guitarist are of the highest quality. They clearly take pride in delivering a quality show. Strongly recommended.
author: petermY8719QG

title: Long live flamenco!
text: Pure feeling! Five great artists performing the best flamenco. The rest of the staff, very attentive and friendly. Hey!💃
author: 657_lvarom
